title: The Myth of Cryogenic Freezing Bodies!

scenes.text: Over 250 bodies are cryogenically frozen each year.
Many believe that all cryogenically frozen bodies will be revived.
scenes.label: All bodies can be revived

scenes.text: Currently, there’s no scientific proof that revived cryogenically frozen bodies can be brought back to life.
scenes.label: No proof of revival
Revival is not guaranteed!
scenes.query: The Myth of Cryogenic Freezing Bodies!

scenes.text: Follow if curiosity runs your brain.

description: Cryogenic freezing may sound like a way to cheat death, but the reality is different. Follow for daily science!
